Armenia
Consular help: Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Moscow, Russia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular biometric passportYESService/Official biometric passportYESDiplomatic biometric passportNO
For citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina, holders of ordinary and service/official passports, visa application can be sumbitted at the Embassy of the Republic of Armenia in Vienna:
Address: Hadikgasse 28, 1140 Vienna, AustriaTel: +43 1 522 74 79, +43 1 890 63 63Fax: +43 1 522 74 79 150E-mail: armaustriaembassy@mfa.amWorking hours: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday 10.00-13.00
Citizens of the Republic of Armenia, holders of valid ordinary and service/official passports are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Citizens of the Republic of Armenia, holders of valid diplomatic passports may enter, exit, travel through or stay in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina in a period of 90 days within a year from the date of their entry.
Safety conditions: There is a risk of traveling in certain areas. This particularly applies for the area bordering Republic of Azerbaijan. Due to high rates of violent crime, special cautiousness is adviced. Armenia is located on a seismically active area.
Sanitary conditions: For longer stay, vaccination is required against malaria, diphtheria, hepatitis B, typhus and fever (especially for persons who have contact with animals).
Foreign exchange standards: Domestic money is paid exclusively in the country. It is recommended to travellers to bring dollars and to change them exclusively in banks, hotels and official currency exchange offices. Changing the euro still faces difficulties. When entering the country, the money that is being introduced is reported to prove that the amount of money on exit does not exceed the amount entered.
